lines.en: I set one foot at a time on the red sand.
A bandage has come loose, and I drag it.
I walk slowly, but I do not stop.

lines.zh: 恶地的热浪在我身边扭曲。
lines.en: Heat shimmer warps the air around me.

lines.zh: 我的关节僵了，每一步都响。
lines.en: My joints are stiff; every step creaks.
I walk along the cracked riverbed.

lines.zh: 红色的土粘在我的布上。
lines.en: Red earth clings to my wrappings.
I go around a dead shrub.

lines.zh: 红沙灌进我的裹布缝里。
lines.en: Red sand pours into the seams of my wrappings.

lines.zh: 我往前走，像在完成一件事。
lines.en: I walk as though finishing a task.

lines.zh: 我身上的布已经褪成土色。
lines.en: My wrappings have faded to earth color.

lines.zh: 风把我的绷带吹得飘起来。
lines.en: The wind lifts my bandages.
I cross a patch of gravel, loudly.
I am slow, but my heading is straight.

lines.zh: 我抬头看了看烧红的天。
lines.en: I look up at the burning sky.

lines.zh: 我一只脚有点跛，照走不误。
lines.en: One foot drags; I walk regardless.
I stand as my wrappings snap in the wind.
I do not breathe, and yet I wait.
Sand gathers on my shoulders.

lines.zh: 正午的太阳把我的影子缩到脚边。
lines.en: The noon sun pulls my shadow in to my feet.

lines.zh: 恶地这种地方，静得厉害。
lines.en: The badlands are terribly quiet.

lines.zh: 恶地的红沙，养出我这身绷带。
lines.en: Badland red sand grew these bandages.
A vulture circles above.
I cannot recall who I was.
I look down at my own hands.

lines.zh: 我坐着，沙从袖口一点点漏。
lines.en: I sit while sand trickles from my cuff.

lines.zh: 我的影子在红土上很短。
lines.en: My shadow is short on the red earth.
I wait for the wind to change.

lines.zh: 我抬起一只手，摊开手掌。
lines.en: I raise a hand and open the palm.
The cracked ground creaks.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把手臂放回身侧。
lines.en: I lower my arm slowly to my side.
Sunset stains the whole badlands red.

lines.zh: 你皮肤的颜色，我很久没见了。
lines.en: I haven't seen skin that color in a long time.

lines.zh: 我很久没见到走路的人了。
lines.en: I have not seen a walker in a long while.
Badlands behind you. No water.

lines.zh: 我眼窝里的沙，被你挡住了光。
lines.en: You block the light from the sand in my eye sockets.
You need not fear me; I cannot walk fast.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛还在，只是干了。
lines.en: My eyes are still here, only dried.

lines.zh: 你的声音在这片地上很响。
lines.en: Your voice carries loudly on this ground.
I remember the sun, and I remember water.

lines.zh: 你要往哪走？那边没有路。
lines.en: Where are you going? There is no path that way.
I raise a hand in greeting.

lines.zh: 这身布条已经陪了我很久。
lines.en: These wrappings have been with me a long while.
Do not touch my bandages.

lines.zh: 绷带散了半圈，我缠不回去。
lines.en: My bandages come half unwound, and I can't rewrap them.
Sand pours from the wound.

lines.zh: 布条底下渗出干沙，不是血。
lines.en: Dry sand seeps through my wrappings, not blood.
I press a hand over the tear.
I am long used to such hurts.
I make a very faint sound.
My body has dried a little more.
I sit down and recover slowly.
Scraps of my wrapping lie on the ground.
I get up and keep walking.
You have raised the water.
My throat is dry as sand.
I reach out, but my hand does not obey.

lines.zh: 香料味一飘，我记得法老的宴席。
lines.en: A whiff of spice and I remember the pharaoh's feast.
Leave it down; I will take it myself.

lines.zh: 我蹲不下去，膝盖是硬的。
lines.en: I cannot crouch; my knees are rigid.

lines.zh: 你退开一点，我就能过去。
lines.en: Step back a little and I can come.

lines.zh: 好香，我快忘了香是什么。
lines.en: So fragrant. I had nearly forgotten fragrance.

lines.zh: 供品放远点，我的腿走不快。
lines.en: Set the offering farther off; my legs don't hurry.
This little water — I begrudge drinking it.
I rest my hand on the rim.
I accept your kindness.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，眼里有点亮。
lines.en: I look up at you; something glints in my eyes.
This body should have dried up long ago.

lines.zh: 你给我水，我就不跟你要别的。
lines.en: Give me water and I will ask nothing more.
I hold it and drink slowly.

lines.zh: 你碰到我的肩，布条散了。
lines.en: You touched my shoulder, and the wrappings shifted.
I am light; I cannot move you.
Sand shakes off me.

lines.zh: 我们错开的时候，我停了停。
lines.en: As we passed, I paused.
My arm rises only slowly.
Do not push; I will come apart.
I steadied; you stepped back.

lines.zh: 这一碰让我掉了一块布。
lines.en: That knocked a strip of cloth off me.

lines.zh: 地上多了一点我的痕迹。
lines.en: There is a bit more of me on the ground.
A step has opened between us.

lines.zh: 我们慢慢走，走多远算多远。
lines.en: Let us walk slowly, as far as we get.
Will you stand with me a moment?

lines.zh: 我很久没和人并排走了。
lines.en: I have not walked beside anyone in a long time.
I raise a hand to touch your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你走在阴影里，我走在外侧。
lines.en: You take the shade; I will take the outside.

lines.zh: 两具木乃伊并排站着，风替我们说。
lines.en: Two mummies stand side by side; the wind speaks for us.
I smooth my wrappings for you to see.

lines.zh: 有你在，恶地也不算太空。
lines.en: With you here, the badlands feel less empty.
I match your pace, slowly.
When night falls, we stop.

lines.zh: 地上那枚圣甲虫，我捡了三次。
lines.en: That scarab on the ground; it took three tries to pick up.

lines.zh: 我捡起来，放在手心里看。
lines.en: I pick it up and look at it in my palm.

lines.zh: 这东西是从谁身上掉的？
lines.en: Who did this fall from?
I hand it to you slowly.
My fingers are stiff; they barely hold.
My wrappings have snagged it.
Red sand in every bandage seam.
This thing smells of long ago.
I tuck it under my wrappings.
Take it; I have no use.
I can only close the distance slowly.

lines.zh: 你踩进我的沙里，走不动了。
lines.en: You stepped into my sand, and now you can't move.

lines.zh: 我的影子已经到你脚边。
lines.en: My shadow has reached your feet.
There is no cover in these badlands.
I raise my hand, and not to strike.
Listen — sand in the wind.
Step by step, I do not stop.

lines.zh: 你别跑，跑起来沙子会呛你。
lines.en: Do not run; the sand will choke you.
I will wait on this road.
You will come this way eventually.

lines.zh: 恶地的红沙，钻进我的布条。
lines.en: Red badland sand works into my wrappings.

lines.zh: 沙丘上的风替你留了路。
lines.en: The wind on the dunes keeps a trail for me.
I do not call out; my throat would crack.

lines.zh: 你在沙丘那边，我看见了。
lines.en: You are beyond the dune. I see you.

lines.zh: 我的布条在风里指着你。
lines.en: My bandages point at you in the wind.
I am in no hurry; the road is long.
You have stopped to drink, have you not?

lines.zh: 你的靴声在恶地传得很远。
lines.en: Your boots carry far across the badlands.
I am behind you, following slowly.

lines.zh: 沙会把我们的脚印都盖住。
lines.en: Sand will cover both our prints.

lines.zh: 我伸出手，只是碰了一下。
lines.en: I reach out and only touch you.
My arm is cold and dry.

lines.zh: 我抬手抓你，沙从指缝漏下。
lines.en: I reach for you, sand leaking through my fingers.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的袖子，然后松开。
lines.en: I catch your sleeve and let go.
You moved too fast; I caught only air.
A bandage loops your wrist.

lines.zh: 我的膝盖一软，差点散在地上。
lines.en: My knees give and I nearly come apart on the ground.
Sand has got in my eyes.

lines.zh: 红沙裹着的手，抬起来了。
lines.en: A red-sand-wrapped hand rises.
I did not mean to hurt you.
I sit up out of the sand.

lines.zh: 恶地的红土上多了一道人形。
lines.en: There is one more figure on the red earth.
Sand still clings to my wrappings.

lines.zh: 我慢慢站起来，身上掉土。
lines.en: I rise slowly, earth falling from me.

lines.zh: 风把盖住我的沙吹开了。
lines.en: The wind has blown the sand off me.
It is drier here than before.
I raise a hand against the sun.

lines.zh: 我从枯河床的方向走来。
lines.en: I come from the dry riverbed.
My feet sink into the red sand.

lines.zh: 这片恶地多了个走路的。
lines.en: The badlands have one more walker.

lines.zh: 火烧到布条，味道很难闻。
lines.en: Fire catches my wrappings, and the smell is foul.

lines.zh: 我倒下去，骨头响了一声。
lines.en: I fall, and a bone clicks.

lines.zh: 水灌进布条，我沉了下去。
lines.en: Water soaks my wrappings and I sink.

lines.zh: 气浪把我的布条全掀起来。
lines.en: The blast flings all my bandages up.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进来，卡在布里面。
lines.en: Something stuck in, caught in the cloth.

lines.zh: 有一股力量想把我推倒。
lines.en: A force tries to push me down.
I can find no water in the badlands.
The flash makes the red earth glare.

lines.zh: 我掉下去，布条在往上飘。
lines.en: I fall, and my wrappings stream upward.
